extraction_notes: Main-text measured performance data occur in Figure 1b, 1d and 1e. Figure 1c is a literature-comparison/per-pass-yield plot and was skipped under the reading rules, even though it includes this-work markers. Figures 2–4 are characterization/mechanistic/DFT figures and contain no measured catalytic performance data to extract. In Figure 1d the GHSV was not printed in the panel/caption for the comparative catalyst bars, so it is left unspecified; pressure and H2/CO2 ratio are taken from the Figure 1 caption, and catalyst mass/feed details from Methods. Values are approximate digitizations from the plotted bars/markers; where the same values are discussed in the text, the plotted point is still reported with qualifier '~'.
